_comment: Which locales search engines may index. Every active locale stays published and reachable through the language switcher; a locale not listed in 'indexed' gets <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow"> on every page, is left out of every sitemap, and is removed from every hreflang cluster. Read by scripts/lib/_locale_indexing.py, the only consumer. History: all locales until v0.0.30 (4 Nov 2026), ten from v0.0.30, English only from v0.0.45 (21 Nov), English and French from v0.0.47 (22 Nov). Since 25 Nov 2026 (ADR-0015, amendment of that date): English plus the twelve locales with at least 10 Google clicks between 11 June and 10 September 2026, the three months before the demotion. 'en' must always be listed.
